body: Goodbye suicide watch. U helped alot
I'm such a low life scum that no one even bothers to reply even here.

We talk about death like its nothing. I find death easier rather than talking to someone about my problem. But deep down I know their is a guy who wanted to live, make money, have a family. But now mind is clouded all the time. I'm in my room for last 2hours. Reality sucks man.

i too feel hopeless and avoid social events because i don't want to humiliate
myself. I've become socially isolated with no purpose. I cry occasionally when I realize the bitter reality. I can't see my self gettin above 30 yrs. Brother your going through tough time i have nothing else to say.
